name: Coconut Context
description:
Coconut Context is the shared, living context layer for your organization, built so humans and AI agents work from the same source of truth.

Most AI tools forget. Every new chat, every new agent starts cold, and you re-explain your customers, your decisions, your product, your house style. Coconut Context fixes that. It's a versioned knowledge base written in plain markdown, readable and writable by both people and agents, and exposed to Claude over MCP.

Connect it once and Claude can:

- Search and read your canonical context (product docs, customer accounts, processes, decisions) instead of guessing
- Write back what it learns, so knowledge compounds across sessions instead of evaporating
- Work in shared spaces (team knowledge) or personal spaces (your own working memory), with permissions that keep the right context in the right hands
- Stay current through versioning, so every change is tracked and reversible

Because it's plain markdown, your context stays portable and human-readable, not locked in a proprietary format you can't inspect. Humans edit it in the Coconut Context app; agents read and update it through the connector.

This is how you ship at agent speed without the slop: give your AI durable, permissioned, organizational memory instead of re-priming it every time.

Coconut Context is part of the Coconut platform for building and running autonomous software agents. Use it on its own, or alongside Coconut's agent runtime and dashboard.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Coconut Context to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Coconut Context to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.coconut.md/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Coconut Context MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coconut Context lists 15 MCP tools, including context_create_personal_page, context_create_shared_page, context_create_space, context_get_personal_page, context_get_shared_page, context_get_shared_page_revisions, context_list_personal_pages, context_list_shared_pages, context_recent_shared_pages, context_search_shared_pages, context_space_list, and context_update_personal_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Coconut Context?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Coconut Context in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Coconut Context MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coconut Context requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Coconut Context is developed by Coconut AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
